name: B10-0163/2024 (Verts/ALE) – EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on EU actions against the Russian shadow fleets and ensuring a full enforcement of sanctions against Russia
part_text:
**What it asks for:** This is an opinion, not a law. The European Parliament asks the European Commission to do more against Russia's "shadow fleet" — old, often uninsured oil tankers Russia uses to sell oil and dodge sanctions. It wants a special EU team to track these ships, more oil-spill clean-up ships, and new sanctions covering all known shadow fleet tankers and their owners. It also wants the EU to ban selling tankers to countries that help Russia, and to ban transferring Russian oil between ships in EU waters.

**Key points:**
- The EU would track shadow fleet ships and add them to sanctions lists.
- Coastal countries and EU waters face less oil-spill risk; ship owners face sales bans.
- The Commission and member states would act; nothing changes yet.
